verdict.rationale: Formant documents the building blocks: anomaly alerts and automated incident response workflows, 'dispatches help the moment something looks wrong', event-triggered webhooks, low-latency teleoperation for operator takeover, and intervention records. Nothing in the evidence describes a dedicated human-intervention queue or an explicit hand-back-to-autonomy step, so the flow appears to require assembly from events, webhooks and teleop. Missing for 10: a documented intervention queue for routing autonomy failures, an explicit resolve-and-hand-back-control mechanism, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
